title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 17: A Place to Come Back To

planning.voiceReason: A family’s fear of humiliation changes through being heard.
planning.earlyCare: Mother keeps a child’s place beside a friend, while the parent hides a report card.
planning.desire: Help a parent bring his son back to temporary classes without humiliation.
planning.obstacle: Ivo expects the teacher to judge his absent son by an old report card.
planning.dramaticChange: The teacher replaces public judgment with a private conversation; Ivo agrees to ask his son what he needs.
planning.sourceBoundary: The centre's teacher, introduced as a new resident rather than a replacement for anyone lost, wants displaced learners to return. A parent worries that absences and old report cards will humiliate their son. Mother helps arrange temporary classes and companionship. The teacher listens before setting the return plan; An contributes without lifting or climbing.
sceneActivities: Mother and Jon arrange a safe outside meeting space; new teacher Sela and parent Ivo exchange a report without displaying it publicly. Supported rest/look/gesture cues only.

actingSignature.Jonathan: Plain practical questions; open hand at a boundary, quiet attention afterward.
actingSignature.An: Specific limits and short questions; supported seated rest while reviewing, no assumed healing.
actingSignature.Min: Urgent explanations soften into admitting uncertainty; rests attentive when corrected.
actingSignature.Mother: Concrete requests and accurate accounting; no presumed forgiveness or renewed station shift.
actingSignature.Sela: Patient concrete questions; does not reach for private report. Quiet open posture and attentive gaze.
actingSignature.Ivo: Begins with explanations and permissions; shifts to asking his son. Guarded hands, then release into attentive rest.

planning.listenerTurn: Sela asks how the son is before looking at the report; listener Ivo, then one separate lowered-hands entry.
planning.payoff: Separate temporary learning courtyard inspected and ready. Teacher Sela and parent Ivo agree that the son may visit, speak privately and choose companionship; Ivo will ask him rather than assume consent. Main centre still needs roof repair; all old memory/water unchanged.
planning.freshQuestion: Can Jon help the class learn without turning every lesson into a demonstration of his own skill?
